name: brunomouradev-ui
description: Biblioteca de componentes (Web Components) estilo DevExpress: DataGrid, PivotGrid e afins.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @brunomouradev/data-grid && npm run build -w @brunomouradev/pivot-grid && npm run build -w @brunomouradev/tree-list
scripts.release: npm run build && npm test && npm run check:compat && npm publish -w @brunomouradev/data-grid -w @brunomouradev/pivot-grid -w @brunomouradev/tree-list
